author: russotragik
quote:
Just bought PS5 Pro to play specifically GTA VI, I was dragged into the hype, and after 10 hours of gameplay, I wish I could just throw everything on the trash and get a refund.

Basically the intro is kind good, but the first tasks are a "Fix it - Handyman Simulator", Im glad the mechanics of mucle and fat from GTA San Andreas are back, but that's basically it, this isn't a Grand Theft Auto game, this is a The Sims VR, or anything else, this falls off completelly from the GTA franchise.

They had 13 years and a lot of GTAO missions like Cayo Perico's to test the fanbase and managed to create new haters, congratulations Rockstar!
